title: tylophora subnuda
intro: Tylophora subnuda, commonly known as the 'Indian ipecac', is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family native to India. It is a climbing shrub with medicinal properties, primarily used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Tylophora subnuda include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in managing conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids like tylophorine and tylophorin, which exhibit therapeutic actions including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects.
